title: Lockheed Martin coherent matter wave beam patent
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Lockheed Martin coherent matter wave beam patent, about unspecified at Lockheed Martin, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um there's a Lockheed Martin patent called a coherent matter wave beam that deals with using the Aharonov-Bohm

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest on a podcast about advanced physics, says the aerospace and defense company Lockheed Martin holds a patent called a coherent matter wave beam. He says it makes use of the Aharonov-Bohm effect, a quantum physics effect in which particles are influenced by electromagnetic fields in places they never pass through. He brings it up as a sign that a big defense firm is working on exotic physics.
